comment: Shipped components that are not npm production dependencies. One entry per line. `texts` are repo-relative files shown in order; `dockerImage` reads the version from the Dockerfile's FROM line. Re-run `node scripts/collect-acknowledgements.mjs` after editing.

components.name: NATS Server
components.role: Embedded JetStream for operation and job state

components.name: SeaweedFS
components.notice: By Chris Lu and the SeaweedFS contributors.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.role: Audio encoding for audiobook export, as the static build fetched by ffmpeg-static
components.notice: The static builds fetched by ffmpeg-static are configured with --enable-gpl and --enable-version3, so the binary is distributed under the GNU GPL version 3 or later. Linux builds by John Van Sickle (https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/). The GPL text and FFmpeg's own licence summary follow.

components.name: LibreOffice Writer
components.role: Headless DOCX to PDF conversion in the Docker image
components.notice: Copyright The Document Foundation and contributors. Installed from Debian's libreoffice-writer-nogui package; the image's /usr/share/doc carries Debian's copyright files for it and its dependencies.

components.name: Whisper
components.role: Word-level alignment (ONNX conversions by onnx-community, downloaded at runtime)

components.name: PP-DocLayoutV3
components.role: PDF layout analysis (ONNX conversion by Bei0001, downloaded at runtime)

components.name: Kokoro-82M
components.role: Local text-to-speech voices (ONNX export by onnx-community, downloaded at runtime)

components.name: Misaki
components.role: English pronunciation dictionaries (downloaded at runtime) and the grapheme-to-phoneme rules ported from them
components.notice: Misaki by hexgrad; Swift port by mweinbach; letter-to-sound rules from the OpenReader iOS app.
